name: io.github.SokolskyNikita/annas-mcp
title: Anna's Archive
description: Search Anna's Archive for ebooks and papers by title, author or DOI and download the file you pick.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The secret key you log in to Anna's Archive with. The server signs in with it and uses it for downloads.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_DOWNLOAD_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Folder for downloaded files. Defaults to annas-archive in your home folder.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_ACCOUNT_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional aa_account_id2 cookie from a signed-in browser, for when signing in with the secret key fails.
